description: Ministry of Defence - Sri Lanka Armed Services Long Service Medal to the personnel award approved by the President Sri Lanka Armed Services Long Service clasp to the personnel award approved by the President
reasoning: This gazette notification announces the award of Long Service Medals and Clasps to military personnel in the Sri Lanka Armed Services. It falls under Public Service Gazettes (Type 8) as it deals with service recognition, awards, and benefits for public sector employees (specifically military personnel), which is a public service administration matter rather than a government structural/personnel change or any of the other specialized categories.
